A few dozen real entries from the Kaikki English, Russian, Latin, Polish, German, Ancient Greek,
Sanskrit, Spanish, French and Italian dumps (2026-10-03), reduced to the fields the trainer reads,
for the end-to-end test. Spanish verb entries keep their clitic (`combined-form`) rows only for
`hacer`. `turkish.jsonl` holds 46 nouns of the Turkish dump (2026-10-03), their declension rows
only (the predicative rows dropped), for the harmony law; and, from the 2026-10-10 dump,
three verbs (`gelmek`, `bilmek` with its second table, `okumak`), two adjectives with
noun tables (`bay`, `kel`) and two names (`Nepal`, `Angola`). `finnish.jsonl` holds 18 nouns and 6 adjectives of the Finnish dump (2026-10-10), and four
verbs (`tulla`, `ottaa`, `pyytää anteeksi`, `ottaa kiinni`), two postpositions (`alla`,
`kanssa`) and a name (`Suomi`). The Ancient Greek `γέγονε` and `βελτίων` come from the 2026-10-09 dump. The English `keep` and
`sleep` (two verbs whose past has its own stem, for the stem slots) come from the 2026-10-09 dump;
`Kennedy` from the 2026-10-10 dump.
`russian-ru.jsonl` holds four entries of the Russian Wiktionary's dump (2026-10-02), for the
test of reading another edition. They come from Wiktionary and are
licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wiktionary contributors, <https://en.wiktionary.org/>,
<https://ru.wiktionary.org/>).
